Generated Narrative: CodeSystem adequacy-interpretation

This case-sensitive code system https://openanimalnutrition.org/fhir/animal-nutrition/CodeSystem/adequacy-interpretation defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
adequate Meets the requirement
deficient Below the minimum

Below a minimum set by the applied standard, including one raised for a caloric restriction or by the AAFCO dry matter factor, and the arginine and large-breed puppy calcium minimums the source template computes from a standard's own rule. Whether a value below a minimum that the source template supplies or computes otherwise is deficient is an open point. Proposed, pending ratification.

excess Above an authoritative maximum

Above an authoritative maximum (maxProvenance authoritative), and not below a minimum set by the applied standard, including one raised for a caloric restriction or by the AAFCO dry matter factor, as stated on the Decile Basis and Band Computation page. Not used above conditional, template-set or derived-provisional maximums. Proposed, pending ratification.

complete-balanced Overall: complete and balanced
not-complete-balanced Overall: not complete and balanced

name: AdequacyInterpretationCS
title: Adequacy Interpretation
description: Per-nutrient and overall interpretations of a diet's nutrient levels against the applied requirement standard. The rules for `deficient` and `excess` are stated, proposed and pending ratification, on the [Decile Basis and Band Computation](band-computation.html) page.
